operation.source_intent: Create or edit an owned WordPress automation schedule from the Schedules workspace, persisting configuration only while enforcing site ownership, supported runtime types, plan limits, SEO entitlement, and safe retry semantics

source_behavior.create_mode: empty source Id creates a new owned schedule
source_behavior.edit_mode: non-empty source Id updates only an existing owned schedule
source_behavior.site_ownership: selected site must belong to the signed-in account
source_behavior.site_name: derived from the owned site rather than trusted from the caller
source_behavior.interval: source UI bounds 1..365 and SaveAsync clamps before persistence; Laravel rejects out-of-range values fail closed
source_behavior.retry_count: source UI bounds 0..10 and SaveAsync clamps before persistence; Laravel rejects out-of-range values fail closed
source_behavior.execution: SaveAsync persists configuration only; QueueNowAsync is a separate source operation

semantics.create: absence of job maps the source empty Id to AutomationCenterJobSaveService::create
semantics.edit: job plus expected_version maps the source existing Id to AutomationCenterJobSaveService::update
semantics.create_retry: Idempotency-Key plus request hash returns the same persisted row for exact replay and rejects divergent reuse with 409
semantics.edit_retry: expected_version optimistic concurrency; exact lost-response replay is a no-op and stale divergent edits return 409
semantics.audit: one automation_center_job_audits row per real create/update mutation
semantics.authoritative_reread: shared service rereads tenant+owner+job and verifies requested safe configuration before returning success

security.csrf: web middleware retained for POST mutation
security.site_ownership: tenant-qualified site lookup; foreign and missing site IDs share 404 behavior
security.job_ownership: tenant plus authenticated owner query; foreign-owner, foreign-tenant and missing direct IDs fail closed

coverage: exact canonical operation identity and web/auth/tenant.context route contract
frontend Schedules workspace binds schedules.save to SaveAsync
create persists server-owned tenant, owner and authoritative site name
create Idempotency-Key replay is stable and divergent key reuse conflicts
edit uses source-style job identity plus expected_version optimistic concurrency
exact edit replay is a no-op and stale divergent edits conflict
guest and missing operations.manage permission fail closed
cross-tenant route, foreign site and foreign-owner direct job IDs fail closed
unsupported types, frequencies, time and numeric bounds fail closed
caller-owned tenant, owner, site-name and secret-like fields are rejected
plan and SEO entitlement denial produces no persisted schedule
one audit per real mutation with authoritative persisted reread
SaveAsync does not dispatch a queue or write generic scheduled_tasks/automation_rules
frontend discovered action validates active tenant and permission and supplies browser idempotency

coexistence.relationship: Both controls intentionally reuse AutomationCenterJobSaveService, but each keeps its own canonical operation identity and source-screen adapter
